name: standard-red-notes
description: Standard Red Notes monorepo for the app, server, and MCP bridge.

scripts.build: yarn build:mcp && yarn build:openclaw && yarn build:app && yarn build:server
scripts.check: yarn typecheck && yarn lint && yarn format:check && yarn test
scripts.ci:contracts: yarn test:ci-tools && node scripts/validate-ci-contract.mjs && yarn test:release-impact && yarn test:release-contract && yarn release:contract && yarn docs:check
scripts.coverage: yarn coverage:clean && yarn coverage:collect:app-core && yarn coverage:collect:app-web && yarn coverage:collect:server && yarn coverage:report
scripts.coverage:collect:app-core: node scripts/coverage.mjs collect --workspace-root app --output coverage/raw/app-core --jobs 2 --jest-workers 1 --workspace packages/api --workspace packages/encryption --workspace packages/features --workspace packages/filepicker --workspace packages/files --workspace packages/models --workspace packages/responses --workspace packages/services --workspace packages/snjs --workspace packages/ui-services --workspace packages/utils
scripts.coverage:collect:app-web: node scripts/coverage.mjs collect --workspace-root app --output coverage/raw/app-web --jobs 2 --jest-workers 1 --timeout-ms 1800000 --workspace packages/web
scripts.coverage:report: node scripts/coverage.mjs report --input coverage/raw --expect app --expect server --output docs/assets/coverage.svg --summary coverage/summary.json
scripts.deps:audit: yarn deps:audit:owned && yarn deps:audit:app && yarn deps:audit:server
scripts.deps:audit:owned: npx npm-check-updates@22.2.9 --workspaces --root --format group --target latest && yarn deps:audit:cli-client && yarn deps:audit:cli-server && yarn deps:audit:e2e
scripts.docs:check: node scripts/export-app-docs-to-pages.mjs --check && yarn docs:screenshots && yarn docs:search:check && yarn docs:links && yarn docs:mermaid
scripts.format: yarn format:mcp && yarn format:openclaw && yarn format:app && yarn format:server
scripts.format:check: yarn format:check:mcp && yarn format:check:openclaw && yarn format:check:app && yarn format:check:server
scripts.lint: yarn lint:mcp && yarn lint:openclaw && yarn lint:app && yarn lint:server
scripts.test: yarn test:script-tools && yarn test:coverage-tools && yarn test:mcp && yarn test:openclaw && yarn test:app && yarn test:server
scripts.test:script-tools: node --test scripts/docs-browser-ui.test.mjs scripts/export-app-docs-to-pages.test.mjs scripts/generate-brand-assets.test.mjs scripts/generate-docs-search-index.test.mjs scripts/validate-docs-links.test.mjs scripts/validate-docs-screenshots.test.mjs scripts/validate-mermaid-docs.test.mjs scripts/verify-backup-restore.test.mjs
scripts.test:server: cd server && yarn build && yarn test
